payload.artist_html: Christian Foth​, Serjoscha W. Evers, Ben Pabst, Octávio Mateus, Alexander Flisch, Mike Patthey & Oliver W. M. Rauhut
payload.credit_html: (2015). "New insights into the lifestyle of Allosaurus (Dinosauria: Theropoda) based on another specimen with multiple pathologies". PeerJ 3: e940. DOI:10.7717/peerj.940. PMID 26020001. PMC: 4435507.
payload.description_html: Pathologic scapula of SMA 0005. (A) Left scapula in anterolateral view, showing the fractured area of the scapula blade (dashed line). (B) Fracture (dotted line) in dorsal view. (C) Fracture (dotted line) in ventral view. (D) Tomogram of the scapula, showing that only the fracture ends constitute a fused bridge between the fracture elements (arrows), which is consistent with a pseudarthrosis. Abbreviations: co, coracoid; cf, coracoid foramen; fr, fracture; gl, glenoid facet; sc, scapula blade. Scale bar = 5 cm.
